use_case_summary: Verdigris builds a customer support agent embedded in their SaaS product. Need hosted API for fast time-to-market; if POC shows predictable latency and acceptable TCO they will commit to Dedicated for steady-state workloads. Must support streaming, deterministic first-token latency (<1.5s p95), and robust function/tool calling to hit KB/Ticket system integrations.
poc_requirements: Traffic footprint: ~5k daily active users for chat, 75 peak concurrent agents
Test flows: KB retrieval + rerank, ticket fetching via tool call, calendar tool for appointment booking
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, per-request traces for tool calls
performance_targets: End-to-end agent response with tool call: <3s typical (including external API for ticket lookup)
Streaming start: visible token stream within 1.5s for 95% of messages
Cost goal: < $X per MAU benchmark (discuss in pricing)
pricing_notes: Customer wants two options: 1) Hosted committed usage discount for steady baseline + burst credits; 2) Dedicated reserved node quote with autoscale add-on. Will compare TCO over 12 months. Ask: explicit burst per-token price and overage mechanics.
internal_risk: Moderate: strong product fit but legal/data residency + burst pricing are primary blockers. If we cannot offer clear Dedicated economics or hosted guarantees, they may pilot with competitor or home-built infra.
